name: KUMA Module — Official School Calendar (Côte d'Ivoire)
description: Official Ivorian primary-school calendar: terms (trimestres), school breaks, evaluations (CP1-CM1 and CM2/CEPE tracks) and public holidays. Self-contained: owns its own tables (mod_calendar_*), mounts as a Hono sub-app or deploys as a standalone Worker.
compatibility: Host codebase evolves freely; the only contract is the versioned HTTP API and the D1 binding name. Breaking changes ship as /v2 alongside /v1.
